title_en: Bank of Jiangxi Co., Ltd. Nanchang Hongcheng Sub-branch v. Shanghai Digital China Co., Ltd. et al. — dispute over loan contract
ruling_gist_en: Where a party appeals only part of the judgment of first instance in a civil case, the people's court may, during the second instance proceedings, conduct mediation on the appellant's claims. full_text_en:
Jiangxi Bank Co., Ltd. Nanchang Hongcheng Sub-branch v. Shanghai Digital China Co., Ltd., et al. — dispute over loan contract

Ruling Summary

Where a party appeals against some items of a civil judgment of first instance, the People's Court may, in the second instance proceedings, conduct mediation regarding the appellant's claims, and after examining the mediation agreement reached by the parties in accordance with law, confirm it and issue a mediation paper. After the mediation paper is served, the judgment of first instance is deemed to be vacated.

For the remaining items of the judgment of first instance that are not involved in the appeal claims and the mediation paper, if upon examination they are not inconsistent with the mediation paper and do not prejudice the lawful rights and interests of the parties, they may be confirmed in the judgment of second instance.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2021) Zui Gao Min Zhong No. 479

Appellant (Defendant at first instance): Shanghai Digital China Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 111 Fuquan Road, Changning District, Shanghai.

Legal representative: Li Yan, Chairman of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Wan Biwen, lawyer of Jiangxi Yangzhongyang Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Deng Hailong, lawyer of Jiangxi Yangzhongyang Law Firm.

Appellee (Plaintiff at first instance): Jiangxi Bank Co., Ltd. Nanchang Hongcheng Sub-branch, domiciled at No. 1013 West Jianshe Road, Xihu District, Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province.

Legal representative: Ye Songming, President of the Sub-branch.

Agent ad litem: Zhu Linlin, lawyer of Beijing Jingshi (Nanchang) Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Liu Ximin, lawyer of Beijing Jingshi (Nanchang) Law Firm.

Defendants at first instance: Nanchang Kailiang Technology Co., Ltd., domiciled at Room 1301, Block A, No. 277 West Nanjing Road, Donghu District, Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province.

Legal representative: Chen Fei, General Manager of the Company.

Defendant at first instance: Chen Fei, male, born on September 15, 1983, Han ethnicity, residing in Xihu District, Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province.

Defendant at first instance: Xiao Xun, male, born on August 11, 1975, Han ethnicity, residing in Xihu District, Nanchang City, Jiangxi Province.

Defendant at first instance: Ji'an Tianji Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled in the Industrial Park of Jizhou District, Ji'an City, Jiangxi Province.

Legal representative: Fu Dongmei, General Manager of the Company.

The appellant, Shanghai Digital China Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Digital China Company), filed an appeal against the civil judgment (2019) Gan Min Chu No. 20 of the Jiangxi High People's Court to this court because of a dispute over a loan contract with the appellee, Jiangxi Bank Co., Ltd. Nanchang Hongcheng Sub-branch (hereinafter referred to as Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch), and the defendants at first instance, Nanchang Kailiang Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Kailiang Company), Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Ji'an Tianji Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tianji Company). This court formed a collegial panel in accordance with law and conducted a public hearing of this case on April 16, 2021. Agents ad litem of the appellant Digital China Company, Wan Biwen and Deng Hailong, and agents ad litem of the appellee Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, Zhu Linlin and Liu Ximin, appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The trial of this case has now been concluded.

Digital China Company's appellate claims: 1. To vacate item 2 of the civil judgment (2019) Gan Min Chu No. 20 of the Jiangxi High People's Court in accordance with law, and to amend the judgment to dismiss all claims of Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch against Digital China Company, i.e., Digital China Company shall not bear the liability for the difference refund or pay liquidated damages; 2. To order Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, Kailiang Company, Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Tianji Company to bear all litigation costs, property preservation fees, evaluation fees, etc. of the first and second instances. Facts and reasons: (I) This case involves a criminal offense and should be transferred to the public security authorities for handling under criminal judicial procedures. The court of first instance failed to transfer it in accordance with law, which constituted an error in the application of law and a violation of legal procedure; (II) The judgment of first instance ordered Digital China Company to bear the liability for the difference refund and pay liquidated damages, which was erroneous in fact-finding and wrong in the application of law; (III) The judgment of first instance found that the amount of RMB 30,823,841.64 already repaid by Kailiang Company was not a repayment of the debt in this case, which was erroneous in fact-finding and lacked sufficient evidence; (IV) Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch had many significant faults, and the judgment of first instance failed to order Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch to bear liability for its own faults, which was contrary to the principle of fairness; (V) The judgment of first instance ordered Kailiang Company to bear the repayment liability and interest, and at the same time ordered Digital China Company to bear the liability for the difference refund and pay liquidated damages, which lacked legal basis.

Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch argued in defense: This case is a civil dispute. Digital China Company failed to perform its obligations under the contract and should bear the liability for the difference refund and pay liquidated damages. The facts found in the first instance were clear, and the appellate claims of Digital China Company should be dismissed.

During the second instance, neither party submitted new evidence.

Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch claimed at the court of first instance: (I) To order Kailiang Company to repay the bank acceptance advance of RMB 84,402,787.42 and interest and penalty interest (interest and penalty interest provisionally calculated as of January 7, 2019, were RMB 9,791,589.98. The interest and penalty interest would be calculated on the basis of RMB 84,402,787.42 at the rate agreed in the Bank Acceptance Draft Acceptance Contract, commencing from February 8, 2018, until the debt is fully repaid); (II) To order Digital China Company to bear the liability for the difference refund for the bank acceptance advance of RMB 84,402,787.42 payable by Kailiang Company under the first claim, and to pay liquidated damages (liquidated damages provisionally calculated as of January 7, 2019, were RMB 3,916,635.99. The liquidated damages would be calculated on the basis of the adv amount at the rate of 2.1 per 10,000 per day, commencing from February 8, 2018, until the debt is fully repaid); (III) To order Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Tianji Company to bear joint and several liability for repayment of the principal and interest of the bank acceptance advance payable by Kailiang Company under the first claim; (IV) To order Kailiang Company, Digital China Company, Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Tianji Company to bear lawyer fees and other expenses incurred by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch for realizing the creditor's rights in this case; (V) To order Kailiang Company, Digital China Company, Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Tianji Company to bear the litigation costs and preservation fees of this case.

The court of first instance found that on March 28, 2016, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch and Kailiang Company signed the Credit Agreement numbered "Jiang Yin Nan Fen Hong Zhi Shou Zi No. 1610504", which stipulated: 1. Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch provided a credit facility of RMB 111,000,000 to Kailiang Company, consisting of a revolving credit facility of RMB 100,000,000 and a one-time credit facility of RMB 11,000,000. 2. The credit period was 12 months, i.e., from March 28, 2016, to March 24, 2017. 3. The comprehensive credit for future delivery rights financing business (guaranteed warehouse model) was RMB 100,000,000 (parent amount). The future delivery rights financing business (guaranteed warehouse model) was a revolving credit facility, the sub-item under which was bank acceptance drafts, with a bank acceptance deposit ratio of not less than 20%. On April 10, 2017, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch and Kailiang Company signed a new Credit Agreement numbered "Jiang Yin Nan Fen Hong Zhi Shou Zi No. 1720816", which stipulated the credit line, credit period, etc.

In March 2016, Digital China Company as Party A (supplier), Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch as Party B, and Kailiang Company as Party C (purchaser) jointly signed the Future Delivery Rights Financing Business Cooperation Agreement, which stipulated: 1. Digital China Company and Kailiang Company entered into a purchase and sale agreement under which Kailiang Company purchased goods from Digital China Company; Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch and Kailiang Company signed the financing credit agreement numbered "Jiang Yin Nan Fen Hong Zhi Shou Zi No. 1610504", under which Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch provided Kailiang Company with a financing credit line. 2. The cooperation period under this agreement was one year, from March 25, 2016, to March 25, 2017. Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch accepted and issued bank acceptance drafts with Digital China Company as the payee for Kailiang Company, and the parties would separately sign a Bank Acceptance Agreement. When Kailiang Company applied to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch for acceptance, it was required to pay an initial deposit into the account, with a minimum deposit ratio not lower than that agreed in the Bank Acceptance Agreement. 3. When Kailiang Company deposited margin into its margin account opened with Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, or made an advance repayment to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch of part of the principal of the financing credit, Kailiang Company would fill out a Goods Withdrawal Application and submit it to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch for withdrawal of goods under the purchase and sale agreement. After verifying that the margin deposited or the principal amount of the financing credit loan repaid by Kailiang Company (i.e., the balance after deducting the interest payable) matched the withdrawal amount in the Goods Withdrawal Application, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch would issue a Delivery Notice to Digital China Company based on the amount of such funds. Upon receipt of the Delivery Notice issued by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, Digital China Company would issue a Delivery Notice Receipt Confirmation to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch and, at the same time, deliver the goods to Kailiang Company in accordance with the amount specified in the notice from Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch. The Delivery Notice issued by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch was the sole proof for Digital China Company to deliver goods to Kailiang Company. Digital China Company guaranteed that all goods delivered to Kailiang Company were only based on the Delivery Notice issued by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, and the goods would be delivered strictly in accordance with the contents of the Delivery Notice, and the cumulative actual delivery amount could not exceed the cumulative delivery amount notified by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch. If Digital China Company failed to deliver goods in the amount specified in the Delivery Notice issued by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, the excess portion would not be counted in the total amount of delivery invoices agreed in this agreement. Any disputes arising between Digital China Company and Kailiang Company therefrom were irrelevant to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, and Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch would not bear any liability for losses of either Digital China Company or Kailiang Company. After receiving the delivery from Digital China Company, Kailiang Company should issue a Goods Receipt Notice to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch. The three parties designated specific personnel responsible for contacting and operating the business under this agreement. The parties reserved seal samples before the business commenced. When handling the business, upon receiving documents such as the Bank Acceptance Draft Receipt Confirmation, Goods Withdrawal Application, Delivery Notice, Delivery Notice Receipt Confirmation, and Goods Receipt Notice, the parties should carefully verify that the seals matched the reserved samples and be responsible for the verification results. 4. Ten days before the maturity of the bank acceptance draft, if the margin corresponding to the bank acceptance draft was less than 100%, i.e., if the total amount of goods delivered as calculated based solely on the Delivery Notice issued by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch was less than the face amount of the draft, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch would issue a Refund Notice to Digital China Company. Upon receipt of the Refund Notice, Digital China Company must unconditionally remit the difference to the bank account designated by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch as required in the Refund Notice. The Refund Notice from Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch would be deemed served on Digital China Company from the date of issuance. If Digital China Company failed to refund in a timely manner, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch had the right to directly claim the above amount from Digital China Company in its own name, and Digital China Company would have no objection to this. Kailiang Company, as the applicant for the bank acceptance draft, must unconditionally make up the margin/repay all the principal and interest of the loan to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch. Upon maturity of the bank acceptance draft/loan, if Digital China Company failed to refund the difference to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch and Kailiang Company failed to make up the margin, resulting in Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch making the advance/Kailiang Company failing to repay the full principal and interest of the loan causing the loan to be overdue, then Kailiang Company should pay the advance/overdue penalty interest to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch at the penalty interest rate stipulated in the corresponding bank acceptance agreement/loan contract. 5. Digital China Company's obligation to refund the difference to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch was independent, and Digital China Company declared and warranted that its obligation to return the difference to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch was unconditional. 6. Any party's breach of any clause of this agreement (including the declaration and warranty clauses) would constitute a default under this agreement, and the breaching party should pay liquidated damages or compensation for damages to the non-breaching party. If the breaching party delayed in performing a monetary obligation, it should pay a late payment fee at the rate of 2.1 per 10,000 per day of the unpaid amount to the non-breaching party. It should also be liable for compensation for any losses caused to the non-breaching party by its default. The scope of compensation for losses included but was not limited to principal, interest, penalty interest, foreseeable profits, and all expenses incurred for realizing the creditor's rights (including but not limited to litigation fees, arbitration fees, preservation fees, announcement fees, appraisal fees, evaluation fees, auction fees, travel expenses, lawyer fees, etc.).

After the expiration of the above agreement, the three parties signed a new Future Delivery Rights Financing Business Cooperation Agreement in March 2017.

On March 28, 2016, Xiao Xun and Chen Fei signed the Maximum Amount Guarantee Contract numbered "Jiang Yin Nan Fen Hong Zhi Gao Bao Zi No. 1610504-003" with Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, agreeing that Chen Fei and Xiao Xun would provide maximum amount joint and several liability guarantee for each creditor's right under all master contracts signed between Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch and Kailiang Company from March 28, 2016, to March 24, 2017. On April 10, 2017, Xiao Xun and Chen Fei signed a new Maximum Amount Guarantee Contract numbered "Jiang Yin Nan Fen Hong Zhi Gao Bao Zi No. 1720816-003" with Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, agreeing that Chen Fei and Xiao Xun would provide maximum amount joint and several liability guarantee for each creditor's right under all master contracts signed between Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch and Kailiang Company from March 28, 2017, to March 27, 2018, with the maximum principal amount of the creditor's rights under the guaranteed master contracts being RMB 108,000,000. Other terms were the same as the 2016 Maximum Amount Guarantee Contract.

After the above contracts were signed, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, Digital China Company, and Kailiang Company conducted transactions in accordance with the guaranteed warehouse transaction model agreed in the Future Delivery Rights Financing Business Cooperation Agreement. From March 2016 to December 31, 2017, Kailiang Company submitted a total of 92 Goods Withdrawal Applications to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, requesting withdrawal of goods amounting to a total of RMB 312,339,000; Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch issued a total of 92 Delivery Notices to Digital China Company, with delivery amounts totaling RMB 312,339,000; Digital China Company issued a total of 89 Delivery Notice Receipt Confirmations to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, confirming delivery amounts totaling RMB 312,339,000; Kailiang Company submitted a total of 89 Goods Receipt Notices to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, confirming receipt of goods amounting to a total of RMB 312,339,000. By February 2018, a total of 105 Goods Withdrawal Applications, 105 Delivery Notices, and 102 Goods Receipt Notices indicated goods amounts of RMB 340,017,964.13, and the goods amounts, quantities, and types recorded in the parties' documents were exactly the same. At the same time, Kailiang Company and Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch signed a total of 110 Bank Acceptance Draft Acceptance Contracts, and Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch collected a margin of 20% of the face amount of each draft from Kailiang Company, and accordingly issued and accepted 134 Bank Acceptance Drafts with Kailiang Company as the drawer and Digital China Company as the payee, with a total face amount of RMB 438,090,000. The judgment of first instance found that the outstanding balance of bank acceptance advances of Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch totaled RMB 84,402,787.42, which was consistent with the total advance amounts recorded in the 41 Jiangxi Bank Bank Acceptance Draft Payment Vouchers from February 8, 2018, to July 31, 2018.

After Kailiang Company failed to timely make up the bank acceptance exposure in accordance with the Bank Acceptance Draft Acceptance Contract, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch issued a total of 49 Refund Notices to Digital China Company from March 5, 2018, to July 18, 2018, all requiring Digital China Company to return the difference between the cumulative delivery amount recorded in the Delivery Notice and the face amount of the bank acceptance draft to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch in accordance with the Future Delivery Rights Financing Business Cooperation Agreement. In a letter reply dated March 29, 2018, Digital China Company stated to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch that according to the reconciliation results up to March 2018, Digital China Company had received bank acceptance drafts totaling RMB 438,090,000, and all goods under those drafts had been delivered, and there was no situation where goods were not delivered after receiving the acceptance drafts. Therefore, there was no factual or contractual basis for refunding to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch. On the contrary, as of March 28, 2018, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch still owed Delivery Notices in the amount of RMB 45,600,561.71, which should have been issued to Digital China Company to make up for the shortfall within four months after delivery as agreed. In this regard, Digital China Company hoped that Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch would carefully review the relevant circumstances, withdraw the refund request in the aforementioned Refund Notice, and issue the outstanding Delivery Notices to Digital China Company as soon as possible.

In August 2018, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch issued two Urgent Letters stating that Kailiang Company should repay the bank acceptance advance of RMB 92,702,805.24, penalty interest, liquidated damages, etc., to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch by August 15, 2018. Digital China Company should pay the amount owed by Kailiang Company to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch by August 15, 2018, and also bear liquidated damages. Chen Fei and Xiao Xun should bear joint and several liability for all debts of Kailiang Company by August 15, 2018.

Each of the 110 Bank Acceptance Draft Acceptance Contracts signed between Kailiang Company and Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch stipulated: The advance payment made by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch would be converted into an overdue loan of Kailiang Company from the date of payment, and overdue interest (including compound interest) would be charged at the daily rate of 5 per 10,000, without the need to notify Kailiang Company to sign another loan contract. According to this agreement, as of January 7, 2019, Kailiang Company should pay a total of RMB 9,791,589.98 in interest and penalty interest for each outstanding advance. At the same time, according to the Future Delivery Rights Financing Business Cooperation Agreement, as of January 7, 2019, Digital China Company should pay a total of RMB 3,916,635.99 in liquidated damages for each outstanding advance.

It was also found that on December 11, 2018, the shareholders (contributors) of Tianji Company resolved: to agree that Tianji Company would provide joint and several liability guarantee to creditor Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch for debtor Kailiang Company, with the scope of guarantee including principal of RMB 84,402,787.42, interest, penalty interest, liquidated damages, and all expenses for realizing the creditor's rights. On the same day, Kailiang Company, Tianji Company, and Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch signed the Guarantee Agreement, and Tianji Company and Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch signed the Maximum Amount Guarantee Contract numbered "Jiang Yin Nan Chang Hong Zhi Gao Bao Zi No. 1720816".

Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, in order to recover the creditor's rights, entered into a "Commission Agency Contract" with Beijing Jingshi (Nanchang) Law Firm. On January 21, 2019, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch transferred RMB 350,000 to Beijing Jingshi (Nanchang) Law Firm, which issued a special VAT invoice.

The court of first instance held that Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch had performed its obligation to provide financing to Kailiang Company in accordance with the agreement, but Kailiang Company breached the agreement by failing to deliver the full amount of the bill payment before the maturity of the bill, resulting in Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch advancing bill payment of RMB 84,402,787.42; Kailiang Company constituted a breach of contract and should bear the corresponding liability for breach. The transaction model in this case was a warehousing receipt financing transaction, i.e., using bank credit as a carrier and bank acceptance bills as a settlement instrument, with the bank controlling the title to goods, the seller being entrusted to hold the goods in custody and providing a guarantee with the difference between the acceptance bill and the margin deposit. After Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch accepted and delivered the bills to Shenzhou Digital Company, it had completed the principal contractual obligations agreed upon in the "Future Delivery Rights Financing Business Cooperation Agreement".

Pursuant to the "Future Delivery Rights Financing Business Cooperation Agreement", within 10 working days after receiving the "Refund Notice", Shenzhou Digital Company must unconditionally remit the difference amount to the account designated by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch in accordance with the requirements of the "Refund Notice". If Shenzhou Digital Company fails to make the refund on time, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch has the right to directly recover the amount from Shenzhou Digital Company in its own name, requiring Shenzhou Digital Company to bear the refund liability for the shortfall in the advance payment. If Shenzhou Digital Company fails to make the refund on time, it shall also pay liquidated damages as agreed in the agreement.

In the "Maximum Amount Guarantee Contracts" respectively signed with Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Tianji Company clearly agreed to provide joint and several liability guarantee for the creditor's rights between Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch and Kailiang Company. Therefore, all the aforesaid guarantors shall bear joint and several liability to repay the debts that Kailiang Company should repay to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch. The court of first instance also upheld Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch's claim that each defendant should pay RMB 350,000 in attorney's fees incurred for realizing its creditor's rights. Based on this, the court of first instance ruled as follows: 1. Within ten days from the effective date of the first-instance judgment, Kailiang Company shall repay to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch the principal of the bank acceptance bill advance payment of RMB 84,402,787.42 and the overdue payment interest of RMB 9,791,589.98 (as of January 7, 2019), and pay subsequent interest at the rate of 0.05% per day from January 8, 2019 until the full payment is made; 2. Shenzhou Digital Company shall bear the shortfall refund liability to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch for the bank acceptance bill advance payment of RMB 84,402,787.42 payable by Kailiang Company in the above item 1, and pay liquidated damages of RMB 3,916,635.99 (as of January 7, 2019) to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, and pay liquidated damages at the rate of 0.021% per day from January 8, 2019 until the debt is discharged; 3. Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Tianji Company shall bear joint and several liability for the principal and interest of the bank acceptance advance payment payable by Kailiang Company in the above item 1, and after assuming the guarantee liability, have the right to recourse against Kailiang Company; 4. Within ten days from the effective date of the first-instance judgment, Kailiang Company shall pay attorney's fees of RMB 350,000 to Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch. The first-instance case acceptance fee of RMB 532,355.07, preservation fee of RMB 5,000, and appraisal fee of RMB 40,000, totaling RMB 577,355.07, shall be borne by Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch in the amount of RMB 6,000, and jointly borne by Shenzhou Digital Company, Kailiang Company, Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Tianji Company in the amount of RMB 571,355.07.

During the second-instance trial of this court, Shenzhou Digital Company and Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch voluntarily reached a mediation agreement. After being legally summoned by this court, the original defendants at first instance, Kailiang Company, Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Tianji Company, all failed to appear in court to participate in the proceedings.

This court holds that Article 9 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China stipulates: "When trying civil cases, the people's courts shall conduct mediation on the basis of voluntariness and lawfulness." Article 172 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China stipulates: "When hearing appeals, the people's court of second instance may conduct mediation. If a mediation agreement is reached, a mediation document shall be prepared, signed by the trial judges and the court clerk, and sealed with the seal of the people's court. After the mediation document is served, the judgment of the original people's court shall be deemed to be vacated." Article 14, paragraph 1 of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Mediation Work of People's Courts" stipulates: "Where the parties reach a mediation agreement on part of the claims, the people's court may first confirm that part and prepare a mediation document." According to the above provisions, where a party appeals only part of the items of a first-instance judgment, the people's court may, in the second-instance proceedings, conduct mediation work on the appellant's claims, and after lawfully reviewing the mediation agreement reached by the parties, confirm it and prepare a mediation document. After the mediation document is served, the first-instance judgment shall be deemed to be vacated. For the remaining first-instance judgment items that were not appealed by any party and are not involved in the mediation agreement, they may be confirmed in the second-instance judgment provided that they do not conflict with the mediation document and do not harm the lawful rights and interests of any other parties.

In this case, the content of item 2 of the first-instance judgment concerns the shortfall refund liability and liquidated damages borne by Shenzhou Digital Company. Among all parties, only Shenzhou Digital Company filed an appeal, requesting the revocation of item 2 of the first-instance judgment and the dismissal of all claims against Shenzhou Digital Company. After being legally summoned by this court, the original defendants did not appear in court to participate in the proceedings and did not participate in this mediation. Through mediation by this court, Shenzhou Digital Company and Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch reached a mediation agreement and requested this court to issue a mediation document. Upon review by this court, the content of the mediation agreement does not violate the law, does not harm the lawful rights and interests of other parties, and does not conflict with the other items of the first-instance judgment. Moreover, with respect to the payments made by Shenzhou Digital Company under the mediation document, Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch expressly undertook in the mediation document that it would not enforce them repeatedly under this judgment. The principal amount paid by Shenzhou Digital Company under the mediation document shall also be correspondingly deducted when calculating interest under this judgment. Therefore, with respect to the mediation agreement reached between Shenzhou Digital Company and Jiangxi Bank Hongcheng Sub-branch, this court will separately issue a mediation document for confirmation outside this judgment, and the first-instance judgment shall be deemed to be vacated as provided by law. For the remaining first-instance judgment items not appealed by any party, this court confirms them in this second-instance judgment.

In conclusion, in accordance with Article 9, Article 170, and Article 172 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 14, paragraph 1 of the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Mediation Work of People's Courts", the judgment is as follows:

1. The civil judgment of Jiangxi High People's Court (2019) Gan Min Chu No. 20 is deemed to be vacated. Shanghai Shenzhou Digital Co., Ltd. and Jiangxi Bank Co., Ltd. Nanchang Hongcheng Sub-branch shall perform their obligations in accordance with the Supreme People's Court (2021) Zui Gao Fa Min Zhong No. 479-1 Civil Mediation Document;

2. Within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, Nanchang Kailiang Technology Co., Ltd. shall repay to Jiangxi Bank Co., Ltd. Nanchang Hongcheng Sub-branch the principal of the bank acceptance bill advance payment of RMB 84,402,787.42 and the overdue payment interest of RMB 9,791,589.98 (as of January 7, 2019), and pay subsequent interest at the rate of 0.05% per day from January 8, 2019 until the full payment is made;

3. Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Ji'an Tianji Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. shall bear joint and several liability for the principal and interest of the bank acceptance advance payment payable by Nanchang Kailiang Technology Co., Ltd. in the above item 2, and after assuming the guarantee liability, have the right to recourse against Nanchang Kailiang Technology Co., Ltd.;

4. Within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, Nanchang Kailiang Technology Co., Ltd. shall pay attorney's fees of RMB 350,000 to Jiangxi Bank Co., Ltd. Nanchang Hongcheng Sub-branch.

If the party obligated to pay money fails to fulfill the payment obligation within the period specified in this judgment, the debt shall be doubled for the period of delayed performance in accordance with Article 253 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

The second-instance case acceptance fee, reduced by half, is RMB 268,127.5, to be borne by Shanghai Shenzhou Digital Co., Ltd.; the first-instance case acceptance fee of RMB 532,355.07, preservation fee of RMB 5,000, and appraisal fee of RMB 40,000, totaling RMB 577,355.07, shall be borne by Jiangxi Bank Co., Ltd. Nanchang Hongcheng Sub-branch in the amount of RMB 6,000, and jointly borne by Shanghai Shenzhou Digital Co., Ltd., Nanchang Kailiang Technology Co., Ltd., Chen Fei, Xiao Xun, and Ji'an Tianji Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. in the amount of RMB 571,355.07.

This judgment is final.
